title: Āsavānaṃ khayo
text: 2. Pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni || katamāni pañca || || Saddhindriyaṃ || la-pe || paññindriyām || || Imāni kho bhikkhave pañcindriyāni || || 3. Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam indriyānam bhavitattā bahulīkatattā bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttim paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī ti || || Mudutaravaggo dutiyo8 Tassuddānaṃ9 || || Paṭilābho ca tayo Saṅkhittā || || Vitthārā apare tayo || Paṭipanno cupasamo || Āsavānaṃ khayo cime ti || || CHAPTER III. CHAḶINDRIYA-VAGGO TATIYO.
